samsung - galaxy tab s12+ - 12.6\" 256gb.description: Whether you’re planning a passion project or simply exploring an idea, Galaxy Tab S12+ helps you focus on whatever catches your attention and bring it to life. A bright 12.6" Dynamic AMOLED 2X display gives your ideas the room to come alive, while the MediaTek Dimensity 9500 processor keeps things moving smoothly, whether you are researching using AI, taking notes, opening another app or creating something of your own. When you want to go deeper, AI experiences help you make more of what you discover. Bring documents, websites and audio files into Gemini Notebook to uncover connections and turn information into helpful summaries, guides and insights. Note Assist with Galaxy AI can summarize, translate and organize your notes, so you can spend less time managing your thoughts and more time following them somewhere interesting. The included S Pen is ready to capture ideas, with a pencil inspired shape and precise tip that make writing, sketching and creating feel natural. With up to 21 hours of battery life and Super Fast Charging 2.0, there’s plenty of power to keep going. And at just 5.3mm thin, with a light design and IP68 rated water and dust resistance, Galaxy Tab S12+ is built with everything you need to take an idea to the next level.
